contract_plain_english: For even N, the probability of obtaining exactly half heads is exactly 2^{-N} binom(N,N/2), and this probability is within fixed positive constant factors of 1/sqrt(N), as can be shown using Stirling's approximation. Consequently, the probability that the normalized head count Z_N equals zero is also within fixed positive constant factors of 1/sqrt(N) (PDF page 3/printed page 14, central-binomial paragraph and footnote 1).
